[[The Path to Combat: Heroes' Ascent]] }} ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== *This quest is only offered to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s. ===Objectives=== *Complete a battle in the [[Codex Arena]]. *See Zenjal [[[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] Guide] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] * [[Strategist's Zaishen Strongbox]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide] :''"The Zaishen's Codex Arena will tax not only your body but your mind as well. The Codex is an ever-changing set of limits on your [[skill]] selection, which will test your adaptability. If your spirit still retains the will to fight, advance to the Codex Arena!"'' {{Offer dialog | accept = I can fight with any limit you place on me! | decline = Let me check my skills first... Wait, what did you say? }} ===Intermediate dialogue === ;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide] :''"To compete in the Codex Arena, you must journey to the Battle Isles. If you wish, I can send you directly to [[Codex Arena (outpost)|the staging area]]. Is your heart prepared for the flames of battle?"'' {{Offer dialog | accept = Let's do it. | decline = Not now. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide] :{{dialogue-stub}}
